## Checklist

- [ ] Target branch is intentional: `dev` for integration, `main` for release-safe changes.
- [ ] Tests or docs were updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or local-only paths were added.
- [ ] Main-targeted PRs do not include dev-only container artifacts.
- [ ] Add `hold` or `do-not-merge` if auto-merge should stay disabled.
